headline: Spain's manufacturing sector expands at fastest pace in one year
summary: Spain's manufacturing activity accelerated in October to its fastest rate of expansion in a year, according to purchasing managers' survey data.
why: Spain has outpaced several larger euro zone peers in recent quarters, making its industrial resilience an important input for euro area growth expectations.

impacts.name: Spain
impacts.why: Factory activity accelerated at the strongest rate in 12 months.
